entries.en: The students replaced the damaged OR circuit before testing their model again.
entries.zh: 学生们更换了损坏的或电路，才再次测试他们的模型。

entries.en: Our diagram connects an OR gate to the warning light.
entries.zh: 我们的电路图把一个或门连接到了警示灯上。

entries.en: A loose cable silenced the PA system halfway through her speech.
entries.zh: 她讲话讲到一半，一根松动的电缆让公共扩音系统没了声音。

entries.en: The technician bent a thin strip of permalloy around the small core.
entries.zh: 技术员把一条薄薄的坡莫合金带弯绕在小芯体周围。

entries.en: The economics class compared real GNP across three imaginary economies.
entries.zh: 经济学课比较了三个假想经济体的实际国民生产总值。

entries.en: The butcher weighed the short loin before wrapping it for the customer.
entries.zh: 肉店师傅称过前腰肉的重量，才为顾客包起来。

entries.en: Our chemistry class compared the Solvay process with an earlier soda ash process.
entries.zh: 我们的化学课比较了索耳未法与一种更早的纯碱生产工艺。

entries.meaningZh: 特别兴趣新闻组〔计算机〕
entries.en: The special interest group exchanged messages about an unfamiliar compiler error.
entries.zh: 那个特别兴趣新闻组交流了有关一种陌生编译器错误的信息。

entries.en: The scanner could not read the universal product code on the crumpled carton.
entries.zh: 扫描器读不出皱纸盒上的通用产品码。

entries.en: The historian compared early experiments on vitamin G with later research on riboflavin.
entries.zh: 历史学家把早期对维生素G的实验与后来对核黄素的研究作了比较。

entries.en: The damaged X-ray tube remained disconnected while the engineer inspected its housing.
entries.zh: 工程师检查外壳时，那支损坏的X射线管一直处于断开连接的状态。

entries.en: A hissing noise from the tyre interrupted our conversation.
entries.zh: 轮胎传来的嘶嘶声打断了我们的谈话。

entries.meaningZh: 非常好笑的人或事〔非正式〕
entries.en: The children's improvised puppet show was a hoot.
entries.zh: 孩子们即兴表演的木偶戏好笑极了。

entries.en: By sunset, rescuing the soaked birthday cake seemed a lost cause.
entries.zh: 到了日落时，挽救那个湿透的生日蛋糕似乎已经毫无希望了。

entries.en: I felt a pang of regret after deleting the unfinished letter.
entries.zh: 删掉那封没写完的信后，我感到一阵懊悔。

entries.en: A shaft of light fell across the dusty piano.
entries.zh: 一束光落在了蒙尘的钢琴上。

entries.en: Her unexpected praise left me with a sort of glow all afternoon.
entries.zh: 她出乎意料的夸奖让我整个下午都感到温暖幸福。

entries.en: A spate of cancellations left the theatre almost empty.
entries.zh: 接连不断的退订使剧院几乎空无一人。

entries.en: Changing the acquisition function led our search towards a less explored region.
entries.zh: 更改采集函数后，我们的搜索转向了一个探索较少的区域。

entries.en: During adaptive stress testing, the simulated vehicle encountered a sudden loss of visibility.
entries.zh: 在自适应压力测试期间，仿真车辆遇到了能见度骤降的情况。

entries.en: She plotted the backward reachable set for a fixed arrival time.
entries.zh: 她绘出了针对一个固定到达时刻的后向可达集。

entries.en: Extending the time horizon changed the backward reachable tube in our example.
entries.zh: 延长时域后，我们这个例子中的后向可达管发生了变化。

entries.en: Our proposed barrier certificate failed the required inequality near the boundary.
entries.zh: 我们提出的障碍证书在边界附近未能满足所要求的不等式。

entries.en: A bumper crop of tomatoes left us sharing baskets with the neighbours.
entries.zh: 番茄大丰收，我们便装成一篮篮分给邻居。

entries.en: The team tightened the chance constraint before repeating the optimisation experiment.
entries.zh: 团队收紧了机会约束，才重复进行优化实验。

entries.en: My joke earned a chilly look from the usually cheerful host.
entries.zh: 我的玩笑招来了那位平常很开朗的主人冷淡的一瞥。

entries.en: The photographer waited for the shadow to move across the cliff face.
entries.zh: 摄影师等着阴影掠过悬崖岩壁。

entries.en: We revised the control barrier function after changing the model's input limits.
entries.zh: 更改模型的输入限制后，我们修订了控制障碍函数。

entries.meaningZh: 控制障碍函数二次规划
entries.en: The control barrier function quadratic program had no feasible solution for that state.
entries.zh: 对于那个状态，控制障碍函数二次规划没有可行解。

entries.en: In our experiment, the cross-entropy method concentrated samples near a shallow local minimum.
entries.zh: 在我们的实验中，交叉熵方法把样本集中到了一个较浅的局部极小值点附近。

entries.en: Replaying the same disturbance trajectory reproduced the abrupt turn in the simulation.
entries.zh: 重放同一条扰动轨迹，再现了仿真中的急转弯。

entries.en: The execution trace showed a restart immediately before the missing output.
entries.zh: 执行迹显示，输出缺失前刚发生过一次重启。

entries.en: We reserved half the simulation budget for failure probability estimation.
entries.zh: 我们把一半的仿真预算留给了失效概率估计。

entries.en: The finite state machine returned to its waiting state after receiving an invalid command.
entries.zh: 收到无效指令后，有限状态机回到了等待状态。

entries.en: The initial state lay outside the forward invariant set we had constructed.
entries.zh: 初始状态位于我们构造的正向不变集之外。

entries.en: The forward reachable set at ten seconds overlapped the target in our model.
entries.zh: 在我们的模型中，十秒时的前向可达集与目标集有重叠。

entries.en: Through the frosted glass, I could see a blurred figure approaching.
entries.zh: 透过磨砂玻璃，我能看见一个模糊的人影正在走近。

entries.en: A few enormous weights made our importance sampling estimate unexpectedly unstable.
entries.zh: 几个极大的权重让我们的重要性抽样估计出乎意料地不稳定。

entries.en: She recorded each costume she lent out in a battered ledger book.
entries.zh: 她把每件借出的戏服都记在一本破旧的登记簿上。

entries.en: We recomputed the likelihood ratio after correcting the proposal density.
entries.zh: 修正提议密度后，我们重新计算了似然比。

entries.en: Metamorphic testing exposed inconsistent results when we reordered the input records.
entries.zh: 我们重新排列输入记录后，蜕变测试暴露了结果不一致的问题。

entries.en: The researcher reassessed monitorability after the sensor stopped reporting timestamps.
entries.zh: 传感器不再报告时间戳后，研究人员重新评估了可监视性。

entries.en: Our most-likely failure analysis found a different disturbance sequence after the model changed.
entries.zh: 模型改变后，我们的最可能失效分析找到了另一组扰动序列。

entries.en: The planner selected a slower motion primitive for the final approach.
entries.zh: 规划器为最后的接近过程选择了一个较慢的运动基元。

entries.en: Removing one edge from the motion primitive graph blocked the planned route.
entries.zh: 从运动基元图中删掉一条边，阻断了原先规划的路径。

entries.en: We kept the nominal distribution fixed while comparing three sampling strategies.
entries.zh: 比较三种抽样策略时，我们保持标称分布不变。

entries.en: Our partial test oracle rejected the negative count but could not assess the ranking.
entries.zh: 我们的部分测试判定器否定了那个负计数，却无法评判排序。

entries.en: We squeezed into the photo booth just before the curtain fell shut.
entries.zh: 帘子落下合拢前，我们挤进了自动照相亭。

entries.en: The probabilistic surrogate model became less certain beyond the observed operating range.
entries.zh: 超出已观测到的运行范围后，概率代理模型给出的不确定性变大了。

entries.en: We broadened the proposal distribution after noticing an unexplored cluster of inputs.
entries.zh: 注意到一簇尚未探索的输入后，我们扩大了提议分布的覆盖范围。

entries.en: The students added a forbidden speed range to their reach-avoid problem.
entries.zh: 学生们给他们的到达—避障问题增加了一个禁止进入的速度范围。

entries.en: Reachability analysis changed our view of the controller's behaviour near the boundary.
entries.zh: 可达性分析改变了我们对控制器在边界附近行为的看法。

entries.en: For that initial region, the one-second forward reachable set missed the target.
entries.zh: 从那个初始区域出发，一秒时的前向可达集没有触及目标集。

entries.en: Unlike the final reachable set, the reachable tube intersected the obstacle.
entries.zh: 与最终时刻的可达集不同，可达管与障碍物相交了。

entries.en: The changed controller had a smaller region of attraction around the equilibrium.
entries.zh: 更改后的控制器在平衡点周围的吸引域更小。

entries.en: The runtime monitor raised an alert when two events arrived in the wrong order.
entries.zh: 两个事件以错误顺序到达时，运行时监视器发出了警报。

entries.en: We enabled runtime verification during the overnight simulation and inspected the alerts next morning.
entries.zh: 我们在通宵仿真期间启用了运行时验证，并在第二天早晨检查了警报。

entries.en: The perturbed initial state fell outside the estimated safe region of attraction.
entries.zh: 受扰动后的初始状态落在估计的安全吸引域之外。

entries.en: The simulator rejected the planned safe transition after we narrowed the corridor.
entries.zh: 我们缩窄通道后，仿真器否决了原计划中的安全切换。

entries.en: The missing sensor records left an important gap in the safety case.
entries.zh: 缺失的传感器记录让安全论证留下了一处重要缺口。

entries.en: The safety filter reduced the proposed acceleration during the simulated manoeuvre.
entries.zh: 在那次仿真机动过程中，安全过滤器减小了所提议的加速度。

entries.en: The robot waited while the safety oracle evaluated a switch to the slower controller.
entries.zh: 安全判定器评估切换到较慢控制器的方案时，机器人等待着。

entries.en: The revised safety specification ruled out a manoeuvre that the old version allowed.
entries.zh: 修订后的安全规约排除了旧版本所允许的一种机动。

entries.en: She used signal temporal logic to express the deadline in the braking requirement.
entries.zh: 她用信号时序逻辑表达了制动要求中的时间限制。

entries.meaningZh: 可供调查的线索或依据
entries.en: The blurred photograph finally gave the detective something to go on.
entries.zh: 那张模糊的照片终于给侦探提供了可供调查的线索。

entries.en: Adding the battery temperature increased the dimension of the state space.
entries.zh: 加入电池温度后，状态空间的维数增加了。

entries.en: The system under test restarted before we could collect its final response.
entries.zh: 我们还没来得及收集最终响应，被测系统就重启了。

entries.en: The two traces had different temporal logic robustness values despite sharing the same failure label.
entries.zh: 尽管失效标签相同，那两条执行迹的时序逻辑鲁棒度值却不同。

entries.en: A faulty test oracle accepted an output that the manual check rejected.
entries.zh: 一个有缺陷的测试判定器接受了人工检查所否定的输出。

entries.en: The test oracle problem became urgent when every simulation produced an unfamiliar trajectory.
entries.zh: 每次仿真都产生陌生轨迹时，测试判定问题变得迫切起来。

entries.en: The budget debate brought us to the meat of the proposal.
entries.zh: 预算辩论让我们触及了提案最实质的部分。

entries.en: Our parcel reached Jimbo a week before we did.
entries.zh: 我们的包裹比我们早一周到达金博。

entries.en: Gish lowered the microphone so the shortest child could reach it.
entries.zh: 吉什把麦克风放低，让个子最矮的孩子够得到。

entries.en: By the time we left Vire, the fog had lifted.
entries.zh: 等我们离开维尔时，雾已经散了。

entries.meaningZh: 格伦伊格尔〔澳大利亚地名〕
entries.en: We reached Gleneagle with a cracked windscreen and an empty water bottle.
entries.zh: 我们到达格伦伊格尔时，挡风玻璃裂了，水瓶也空了。

entries.en: Dicken offered his seat to someone carrying a sleeping baby.
entries.zh: 迪肯把座位让给了一位抱着熟睡婴儿的人。

entries.en: Owain kept practising until the difficult piano passage sounded smooth.
entries.zh: 欧文不断练习，直到那段难弹的钢琴乐段变得流畅。

entries.en: Our week in Lochaber began with a missing suitcase.
entries.zh: 我们在洛哈伯的一周从丢失一只行李箱开始。

entries.en: Mrs Vardon brought extra folding chairs for the rehearsal.
entries.zh: 瓦登夫人为排练带来了额外的折叠椅。

entries.en: Mr Tancred apologised for bringing the wrong set of keys.
entries.zh: 坦克雷德先生为带错一套钥匙而道歉。

entries.en: We spent our first evening in Adelphi unpacking kitchen utensils.
entries.zh: 在阿德尔菲的第一个晚上，我们忙着拆包整理厨房用具。

entries.en: Rain followed us all the way to Coire.
entries.zh: 雨一路伴着我们，直到到达库尔。

entries.en: Dr Hatchard returned the borrowed projector before lunch.
entries.zh: 哈查德博士在午饭前归还了借来的投影仪。

entries.en: Longland noticed the loose wheel before anyone pushed the trolley.
entries.zh: 还没人推手推车，朗兰就发现了松动的车轮。

entries.en: Giri wrapped the broken handle in cloth before picking it up.
entries.zh: 吉里先用布包住破损的把手，才把它拿起来。

entries.en: Trew saved the last slice of cake for the late arrival.
entries.zh: 特鲁把最后一块蛋糕留给了那个迟到的人。

entries.en: The photographer planned a journey across the Pamir with an old friend.
entries.zh: 摄影师计划与一位老友一起穿越帕米尔高原。

entries.en: Aske refused to leave until the missing cat came home.
entries.zh: 阿斯克坚持等到走失的猫回家才肯离开。

entries.en: Ms Fielden found a quiet corner to finish her drawing.
entries.zh: 菲尔登女士找了个安静角落，好把自己的画画完。

entries.en: Sieg carried the muddy boots outside rather than across the carpet.
entries.zh: 西格把沾泥的靴子拿到外面，没有带着它们走过地毯。

entries.en: Behn remembered the tune but could not recall the words.
entries.zh: 贝恩记得曲调，却想不起歌词。

entries.en: Mr Parrish held the ladder while I retrieved the kite.
entries.zh: 我取风筝时，帕里什先生扶着梯子。

entries.en: We watched Cosi together, then argued about our favourite scenes.
entries.zh: 我们一起看了《科丝姑娘》，随后为各自最喜欢的场景争论起来。

entries.en: Ms Waals placed a bowl beneath the dripping tap.
entries.zh: 瓦尔斯女士把一只碗放在了滴水的龙头下面。

entries.en: Hunte stayed behind to sweep the empty stage.
entries.zh: 亨特留下来清扫空舞台。

entries.en: Hadlee laughed when the dog returned with a much larger stick.
entries.zh: 狗叼回一根大得多的棍子时，哈德利笑了。

entries.en: Praed read the instructions twice before unfolding the tent.
entries.zh: 普雷德把说明读了两遍，才展开帐篷。

entries.en: Jopling borrowed my scarf and walked home through the wind.
entries.zh: 乔普林借了我的围巾，顶着风步行回家。

entries.en: Mrs Faithfull asked us to leave the gate unlatched.
entries.zh: 费思富尔夫人请我们别把门闩上。

entries.en: Gloster smiled at the uneven loaf cooling on the rack.
entries.zh: 格洛斯特看着架上正在冷却的那个形状不匀的面包，笑了。

entries.en: The last postcard in the bundle had been sent from Wickede.
entries.zh: 那捆明信片中的最后一张是从维克德寄出的。

entries.en: In our play, Svengali loses his temper over a missing umbrella.
entries.zh: 在我们创作的戏里，斯文加利为一把丢失的伞发了脾气。

entries.en: Our visit to Tolpuddle lasted longer than we had planned.
entries.zh: 我们在托尔帕德尔停留的时间比原计划更长。

entries.en: Quelle lent me a magnifying glass to examine the damaged stamp.
entries.zh: 奎尔借给我一个放大镜，让我查看那枚受损的邮票。

entries.en: Comper waited for the applause to fade before speaking.
entries.zh: 康珀等掌声平息后才开口。

entries.en: Mr Tennent arrived with a toolbox instead of the promised cake.
entries.zh: 坦南特先生带来的是工具箱，而不是先前答应带的蛋糕。

entries.en: Dr Wych moved the meeting outdoors when the power failed.
entries.zh: 停电后，威奇博士把会议转到了室外。

entries.en: A delayed delivery kept our team in Rosso for another night.
entries.zh: 货物延迟送达，让我们团队在罗索又留了一夜。

entries.en: We arrived in Canadensis after the children had fallen asleep.
entries.zh: 我们到达卡纳登西斯时，孩子们已经睡着了。

entries.en: Evershed folded the programme into a fan during the interval.
entries.zh: 中场休息时，埃弗谢德把节目单折成了扇子。

entries.en: Aurea found a tiny shell in the pocket of her coat.
entries.zh: 奥雷娅在外套口袋里发现了一枚小小的贝壳。

entries.en: Ms Arkell returned the violin with a handwritten thank-you note.
entries.zh: 阿克尔女士归还小提琴时，附上了一张手写的致谢便条。

entries.en: Buse kept one hand on the vase as the train jolted.
entries.zh: 火车颠簸时，布斯一直用一只手护着花瓶。

entries.en: Chirwa caught the falling tray before the cups hit the floor.
entries.zh: 奇尔瓦在杯子落地前接住了掉落的托盘。

entries.en: Rumpole discovered that the spare room was full of bicycles.
entries.zh: 朗波尔发现，备用房间里放满了自行车。

entries.en: Aagaard suggested moving the picnic beneath the trees.
entries.zh: 埃格德建议把野餐地点移到树下。

entries.en: Aaliyah put the sleeping kitten gently into its basket.
entries.zh: 阿莉娅把睡着的小猫轻轻放进了篮子里。

entries.en: Aamodt repaired the torn curtain before the guests arrived.
entries.zh: 阿莫特在客人到来前修补好了破窗帘。

entries.en: The photograph reminded me of our rainy afternoon in Aarberg.
entries.zh: 那张照片让我想起了我们在阿尔贝格度过的那个雨天午后。

entries.meaningZh: 阿尔斯霍特〔比利时地名〕
entries.en: We left a suitcase with friends in Aarschot.
entries.zh: 我们把一只行李箱留在了阿尔斯霍特的朋友那里。

entries.en: Aasen counted the children again before closing the minibus door.
entries.zh: 关上小巴车门前，奥森又数了一遍孩子的人数。

entries.en: Our hired car broke down just before we reached Abadia.
entries.zh: 我们租的车就在快到阿瓦迪亚时抛锚了。

entries.en: The final parcel for Abalak contained the missing cooking pots.
entries.zh: 最后一件寄往阿巴拉克的包裹里装着缺少的炊锅。

entries.en: She kept the postcards from Abana in a biscuit tin.
entries.zh: 她把从阿巴纳寄来的明信片保存在饼干盒里。

entries.en: Abarbanel took the smaller bag so I could carry the lamp.
entries.zh: 阿巴伯内尔拿了较小的袋子，好让我腾手拿灯。

entries.en: Abbell fetched his reading glasses before examining the tiny print.
entries.zh: 阿贝尔取来老花镜，才查看那些小字。

entries.en: Abbett paused at the doorway to shake water from his hat.
entries.zh: 阿贝特在门口停下，抖去帽子上的水。

entries.en: Abbitt arranged the postcards from smallest to largest.
entries.zh: 阿比特按从小到大的顺序摆好了明信片。

entries.en: Abeel noticed that my shoelace had caught under the chair.
entries.zh: 阿比尔发现，我的鞋带卡在椅子下面了。

entries.en: Abegglen walked back to retrieve the forgotten picnic blanket.
entries.zh: 阿贝格伦走回去，取那条忘拿的野餐毯。

entries.en: Mrs Abell asked whether the faded curtains could be dyed.
entries.zh: 艾贝尔夫人询问，褪色的窗帘能不能染色。

entries.en: Abeloff set the alarm early enough to catch the first bus.
entries.zh: 阿贝洛夫把闹钟设得足够早，以便赶上第一班公交车。

entries.en: We returned to Abenheim to collect the bicycle we had left behind.
entries.zh: 我们回到阿本海姆，取走先前留下的自行车。

entries.en: Abercorn offered me the dry gloves and kept the damp pair.
entries.zh: 阿伯康提出把干手套给我，自己留着湿的那副。

entries.en: Mr Abercromby caught a spelling mistake in the wedding invitations.
entries.zh: 阿伯克龙比先生发现了婚礼请柬中的一个拼写错误。

entries.en: Ms Abernathy stayed beside the lost child until his father arrived.
entries.zh: 阿伯内西女士一直陪着那个走失的孩子，直到他父亲到来。

entries.en: Our evening in Abertura ended with a long conversation about home.
entries.zh: 我们在阿韦图拉的那个晚上，以一场关于家乡的长谈结束。

entries.en: Abigayle refused to let the burnt toast spoil her morning.
entries.zh: 阿比盖尔不肯让烤焦的吐司坏了早晨的心情。

entries.en: The box from Abiko contained a carefully wrapped ceramic bowl.
entries.zh: 从日本我孙子寄来的箱子里装着一只包得很仔细的陶碗。

entries.en: A friend sent a painting from Abiquiu as a wedding gift.
entries.zh: 一位朋友从阿比丘寄来一幅画，作为结婚礼物。

entries.en: Abish left a light on for the late guests.
entries.zh: 阿比什为晚到的客人留了一盏灯。

entries.en: We had almost reached Abisko when I realised I had the wrong bag.
entries.zh: 我们快到阿比斯库时，我才意识到自己拿错了包。

entries.en: She spent the journey to Abitibi sketching faces in her notebook.
entries.zh: 她在前往阿伯蒂比的途中，一直在笔记本里画人像。

entries.en: Ablard tested each pen before choosing one for the invitation.
entries.zh: 阿布拉德试过每一支笔，才选了一支来写请柬。

entries.en: Ablin carried the injured bird in an open cardboard box.
entries.zh: 埃布林用一只敞口纸盒带着那只受伤的鸟。

entries.en: Abourezk spotted the missing button beside the sewing machine.
entries.zh: 阿布雷兹克在缝纫机旁发现了那颗不见的纽扣。

entries.en: Aboyne offered a quiet room to the exhausted visitor.
entries.zh: 阿博因给那位疲惫的访客提供了一个安静房间。

entries.en: Dr Abrahamson lent me a bicycle while mine was being repaired.
entries.zh: 我的自行车送修期间，亚伯拉罕森博士借了一辆给我。

entries.en: Abramovitz put a cushion between the cello and the car door.
entries.zh: 阿布拉莫维茨在大提琴与车门之间垫了一个靠垫。

entries.meaningZh: 阿布兰特什〔葡萄牙地名〕
entries.en: The letter from Abrantes arrived after its sender had already returned.
entries.zh: 从阿布兰特什寄来的信到达时，寄信人已经回来了。

entries.en: Abravanel kept humming while searching for the missing sheet music.
entries.zh: 阿布拉瓦内尔一边哼曲，一边寻找不见的乐谱。

entries.meaningZh: 阿夫雷戈〔哥伦比亚地名〕
entries.en: Our plans for Abrego changed when two friends decided to join us.
entries.zh: 两位朋友决定同行后，我们前往阿夫雷戈的计划改变了。

entries.en: Abril tied a bright ribbon around her suitcase handle.
entries.zh: 阿布丽尔在行李箱把手上系了一条鲜艳的丝带。

entries.en: The painter studied photographs of the Absaroka Range before choosing her colours.
entries.zh: 画家研究了阿布萨罗卡岭的照片，才选择自己的用色。

entries.meaningZh: 阿布萨罗卡岭〔山岭名，复数形式〕
entries.en: The travellers argued over which photograph best captured the Absarokas.
entries.zh: 旅人们争论着，哪张照片最能呈现阿布萨罗卡岭的风貌。

entries.en: We unpacked the car in Absarokee as the evening grew cooler.
entries.zh: 傍晚渐凉时，我们在阿布索罗基把车上的行李卸了下来。

entries.en: Her invitation for us to visit Absecon arrived with a hand-drawn map.
entries.zh: 她邀请我们去阿布西肯的请柬，附着一张手绘地图。

entries.en: Abshire chose the quietest table so we could hear each other.
entries.zh: 阿布希尔选了最安静的一张桌子，让我们能听清彼此说话。

entries.en: Absolom was relieved to find the spare key still worked.
entries.zh: 发现备用钥匙仍能使用，阿布索龙松了一口气。

entries.en: Abston balanced the tray carefully while stepping over the sleeping dog.
entries.zh: 阿布斯顿跨过那只睡着的狗时，小心地端稳托盘。

entries.en: Our film club postponed its screening of Absurdistan until everyone could attend.
entries.zh: 我们的电影俱乐部推迟了《荒诞主义者》的放映，等到大家都能参加。

entries.en: Aburdene asked for a pencil rather than marking the score in ink.
entries.zh: 阿伯迪恩要了一支铅笔，没有用墨水笔在乐谱上作标记。

entries.en: Acampora held the curtain aside while the children carried their props backstage.
entries.zh: 孩子们把道具搬到后台时，阿坎波拉把幕布掀在一旁。

entries.en: We had to repack our bags before leaving Acatzingo.
entries.zh: 离开阿卡钦戈之前，我们不得不重新整理行李。

entries.en: Standing in the hallway, Accola noticed the smell of burning toast.
entries.zh: 阿科拉在走廊里闻到了吐司烤焦的味道。

entries.meaningZh: 阿西乐特快〔列车服务名〕
entries.en: I boarded Acela with a suitcase and a half-finished crossword.
entries.zh: 我带着一只行李箱和一份做了一半的填字游戏，上了阿西乐特快。

entries.en: Aceti helped me untangle the necklace without breaking its clasp.
entries.zh: 阿切蒂帮我解开缠在一起的项链，没有弄坏搭扣。

entries.meaningZh: 阿查卡奇〔玻利维亚地名〕
entries.en: The rain stopped just as our vehicle entered Achacachi.
entries.zh: 我们的车刚进入阿查卡奇，雨就停了。

entries.en: Achatz put the fragile cups on a separate shelf.
entries.zh: 阿卡兹把易碎的杯子放在了单独一层架子上。

entries.en: Her reading group chose a novel by Achebe for its next meeting.
entries.zh: 她的读书小组选了一部阿契贝的小说，准备在下次聚会时讨论。

entries.en: We sent our friends in Achete a photograph of the finished garden.
entries.zh: 我们给阿谢蒂的朋友们寄了一张花园完工后的照片。

entries.en: I realised in Achim that I had left my notebook at home.
entries.zh: 到了阿希姆，我才发现把笔记本忘在家里了。

entries.en: My mother's sister sent letters from Achimota, always with sketches of her new garden.
entries.zh: 我姨妈从阿奇莫塔寄来的信，总会附上她新花园的速写。

entries.en: The seminar compared two travellers' accounts of Achin.
entries.zh: 研讨课比较了两位旅行者对亚齐的记述。

entries.en: Achtemeier brought a spare torch for the walk back.
entries.zh: 阿赫特迈耶为回程步行带来了一支备用手电筒。

entries.en: Achtenberg returned the umbrella before I realised it was missing.
entries.zh: 我还没发现伞不见了，阿赫滕伯格就把它还了回来。

entries.en: Ackerly checked both coat pockets before asking to borrow a pen.
entries.zh: 阿克利检查了外套的两个口袋，才开口借笔。
